title: Left out for now
body_template: Safety first — we've left {nutrient} out of your suggestions, since it doesn't pair well with {medication}. This is general wellness guidance — your prescriber can advise on what's right for you.

title: We're watching this
body_template: Safety first — because you take {medication}, your plan keeps an eye on your {nutrient} pattern. If it drifts outside your typical range we'll surface it, and your clinician is the best person to review it.

title: Good to know
body_template: Safety first — {nutrient} and {medication} can influence each other, and your plan already accounts for this. Your prescriber or pharmacist can tell you more if you'd like.

title: Adjusted for your medication
body_template: Safety first — we've paused the {nutrient} suggestion in your plan, because it can interact with {medication}. Please check with your prescriber or pharmacist before changing your {nutrient} intake.

title: Timing tip
body_template: Safety first — it helps to space {nutrient}-rich foods and {medication} apart during the day, so they don't get in each other's way. Your pharmacist can confirm the best spacing for you.

title: Keep it steady
body_template: Safety first — with {medication}, keeping your {nutrient} intake steady day to day helps things stay consistent — aim for a similar amount rather than big swings.

title: Food-first support
body_template: Safety first — {medication} can affect your {nutrient} levels over time, so your plan gently favours {nutrient}-rich foods. Discuss any supplement changes with your clinician.
